inputs.name: Query
inputs.value:
traces
| where timestamp >= ago(1h)
| where customDimensions["service.name"] == "Marain.Tenancy"
| where customDimensions["operation.type"] in ("create", "get", "delete", "list")
| summarize count() by bin(timestamp, 5m), tostring(customDimensions["operation.type"])
| order by timestamp asc

inputs.name: Query
inputs.value:
requests
| where timestamp >= ago(1h)
| where name contains "tenant"
| summarize 
    SuccessRate = round(100.0 * countif(success == true) / count(), 2),
    TotalRequests = count(),
    AvgDuration = round(avg(duration), 2),
    P95Duration = round(percentile(duration, 95), 2)
    by bin(timestamp, 5m)
| order by timestamp asc

inputs.name: Query
inputs.value:
traces
| where timestamp >= ago(24h)
| where customDimensions["service.name"] == "Marain.Tenancy"
| where isnotempty(customDimensions["tenant.id"])
| summarize 
    Operations = count(),
    UniqueOperations = dcount(customDimensions["operation.type"]),
    AvgDuration = round(avg(duration), 2),
    LastSeen = max(timestamp)
    by TenantId = tostring(customDimensions["tenant.id"])
| top 20 by Operations desc

inputs.name: Query
inputs.value:
exceptions
| where timestamp >= ago(1h)
| where customDimensions["service.name"] == "Marain.Tenancy"
| summarize ErrorCount = count() by 
    ErrorType = type,
    OperationType = tostring(customDimensions["operation.type"]),
    bin(timestamp, 15m)
| order by timestamp desc

inputs.name: Query
inputs.value:
customMetrics
| where timestamp >= ago(1h)
| where name in ("tenant.operations.total", "tenant.operation.duration")
| summarize 
    TotalOperations = sumif(value, name == "tenant.operations.total"),
    AvgDuration = avgif(value, name == "tenant.operation.duration")
    by bin(timestamp, 5m)
| order by timestamp asc
